title.narrative: Enhanced opportunities and equal treatment of vulnerable populations in the world of work

description.narrative: This Country Programme Outcome (CPO) focuses on promoting equal treatment and opportunities for vulnerable and marginalized populations in Kenya’s workforce, including persons with disabilities, women, and youth. These groups continue to face barriers such as discrimination, limited access to social protection, education, health, and employment services. To address these challenges, the ILO will strengthen the capacities of national stakeholders to promote gender equality, non-discrimination, and workplace inclusion. Key interventions include developing inclusive employment guidelines, implementing strategies to combat stigma and discrimination; particularly related to disability, and delivering capacity-building programmes on the rights of persons with disabilities targeting government and non-government actors. A core element of this outcome involves tackling violence and harassment in the world of work, particularly sexual and gender-based violence (SGBV). The ILO will support Kenya’s efforts to ratify and implement the Violence and Harassment Convention, 2019 (No. 190), through technical assistance, strategy development, enforcement support, and awareness-raising among employers and workers. It will also address the "Triple Threat" of new HIV infections, teenage pregnancies, and SGBV; especially among adolescents and youth, by working with relevant ministries and partners to scale up comprehensive awareness initiatives and strengthen access to sexual and reproductive health education and services. Key beneficiaries include marginalized and at-risk groups who will benefit from inclusive employment, enhanced workplace protections, and improved access to essential services. The ILO will collaborate with government bodies, trade unions, employers’ organizations, and civil society groups to ensure multi-stakeholder engagement in designing and delivering inclusive and rights-based interventions that advance dignity, equality, and decent work for all.
